# Portrait Stage for Atlas VTT — stage renderer (vendored)

Copied unchanged from Portrait Stage for Atlas VTT 0.5.0 (MIT, by Marco): the stage's renderer, layout, effects
and types. The join page (`online-client/addons/portraitStage.mts`) draws the GM's stage with it. Update by copying the
same files from a newer release and bumping `SOURCE.json`.
